positions.as_written: Expect fixation to be the limiting factor early and the graft later.
Treat graft choice as a trade rather than a ranking.
Avoid allograft in young active patients, on registry failure data.
Plan revision graft choice from tunnel condition and available autograft rather than from the primary algorithm.
